title: ToT Storefront scripts.json
description: Registered widget/script bundles. Scripts are NEVER inline — they are registered here and served by the platform. Sandboxed by default (opaque-origin iframe with no access to page cookies/DOM/age gate/checkout). Regulated tenants MUST use isolation: sandbox.

slot.description: Where the widget mounts. product.aside = beside product purchase controls; home.section = between homepage sections; global.footer = near the footer on every route.

isolation.description: sandbox (default) = opaque-origin iframe, no page access. inline = warned same-origin tier; NEVER for regulated tenants.
